title: neomammillaria prolifera var. haitiensis
intro: Neomammillaria prolifera var. haitiensis, commonly known as Haitian pincushion cactus, is a variety of cactus plant that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neomammillaria prolifera var. haitiensis include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity against certain pathogens. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides in this plant, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
